description: Base proof of payment: Verifies a Base mainnet transaction hash as a token payment: receipt status, block time, confirmations, every ERC-20 Transfer it emitted for the token (USDC by default), and pass/fail checks against an expected recipient and minimum amount. Source: Base mainnet RPC. Not a settlement guarantee. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: status, block, block_time, confirmations, transfers[{from, to, amount}], checks{}, verified.

expected_to.description: recipient address the payment must have reached (default: any)

token.description: ERC-20 contract to inspect (default USDC on Base)

name: x420_chain_proof-of-payment
